name: Both Sides of Making
thesis: A dark plum editorial composition threads the transparent Monstrosity through an enormous name, then treats physical engineering and digital/community work as two readings of one person.
interaction: Physical and Digital buttons shift the machine’s visual emphasis and crossfade the opening story; the control also responds to arrow, Home, and End keys. Chapter links lead to the letter, open-source machines, and shared work.
why: Oversized layered typography and real hardware carry the favorite object-led direction into a richer portrait, with an intimate letter and substantive sections for Svelte and TypeScript, Stardance contributions, makerspace teaching, robotics leadership, and Outpost peer support.
